name: Vectara
tagline: Managed RAG-as-a-service with built-in hallucination control.
description: Vectara is an enterprise GenAI platform that delivers retrieval-augmented generation as a managed service, bundling ingestion, embedding, retrieval, reranking, and grounded generation behind one API. It ships first-party retrieval and generation models and a built-in hallucination-evaluation model (HHEM) to measure and reduce ungrounded answers. It targets regulated, accuracy-critical applications and AI agents.
insight: Founded in 2022 by ex-Google AI researchers; CEO Amr Awadallah earlier co-founded Cloudera.

modelSupport.notes: First-party Boomerang (embeddings), Mockingbird (RAG LLM), and the HHEM hallucination-evaluation model.

edge: Fully managed end-to-end RAG (ingest, retrieve, generate) behind one API, plus first-party retrieval and generation models, not a DIY stack.
pros: SaaS, VPC, or on-prem deployment options
cons: Less flexible than a DIY RAG stack
Core platform is proprietary (only tools open)
